skill_name: Compare the roles and responsibilities of Senior and Junior developers
workflow: The main difference in roles and responsibilities between Senior and Junior Developers is the level of experience and autonomy. Senior Developers are expected to have more technical expertise, be able to lead projects and act as a mentor for junior developers. Senior Developers coordinate their work with other departments and manage their own tasks, also handling last-minute changes, if required.
